shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional {variant} {sport_label} athlete for the {tier_label} tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. {identity} {stage} {palette} Outfit: {kit} Equipment: {equipment} Award: {award} Pose: {pose} Tier silhouette direction: {pose_direction} {framing} Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

stages.bronze: Visibly junior athlete, approximately 12–14, natural youthful face and proportions, modest practical kit; no adult musculature or jewellery.
stages.silver: Older teenager, approximately 15–17; subtly lengthened facial proportions and developing posture, visibly older than Bronze.
stages.gold: Young adult, approximately 18–22; face and body read as adult rather than a child in first-team clothing.
stages.platinum: Adult athlete, approximately 23–27; clearly mature facial structure, natural eye size and less rounded cheeks, confident posture.
stages.diamond: Experienced adult, approximately 26–30; mature face and composed leadership expression, not a copied junior face.
stages.elite: Established elite adult, approximately 28–33; developed adult facial proportions and assured bearing, restrained natural expression lines.
stages.champion: Highly accomplished adult, approximately 30–36; recognisable mature identity, seasoned expression and controlled posture; no exaggerated muscles or ageing.
stages.unreal: Mature adult, approximately 32–40; clearly adult face and natural subtle expression lines, composed awards-night bearing, equal tailored trouser-suit quality for both appearances.

framing.default: Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed.
framing.unreal: Square awards portrait, head to mid-thigh; hands and final award fully visible, 6–8% clear transparent margins, face and award dominate without touching the edges.

pose_directions.bronze: Relaxed introductory three-quarter view; natural asymmetrical weight distribution and curious expression. Establish the junior identity without a stiff catalogue stance.
pose_directions.silver: Turn torso toward the opposite side from Bronze; present early recognition with a pleased, modest expression and clearly different hand placement.
pose_directions.gold: Sport-appropriate ready or controlled action stance: staggered feet, gently bent knees and focused expression. Keep equipment and trophies safely readable, no cropped limbs.
pose_directions.platinum: Controlled forward step or open diagonal stance, with a new arm/equipment arrangement and adult confidence; avoid repeating Gold or Bronze.
pose_directions.diamond: Composed leadership stance, broader grounded base and a calm direct expression; distinguish it from the action and walking silhouettes.
pose_directions.elite: Restrained celebration or podium presentation, an open gesture when hands are available, stronger vertical silhouette and pleased expression. Never invent an extra hand to hold equipment and awards.
pose_directions.champion: Confident three-quarter contrapposto facing a different direction from Elite, relaxed shoulders and compact trophy group. Athlete stays dominant; do not duplicate the Elite stance.
pose_directions.unreal: Formal three-quarter portrait with a mature face, award held naturally at waist-to-chest height and composed expression. Deliberate head-to-mid-thigh crop; distinct from the playing poses.
